quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 interim financial statements (6-K): remaining performance obligations were $37,490.6 million as of June 30, 2026, of which 36% is expected to be recognized as revenue during the 24 months ending June 30, 2028, 40% between months 25 and 48, and the remainder thereafter; the amounts are fully attributed to the Nebius AI cloud business. Deferred revenue (current and non-current), primarily prepayments under strategic customer agreements, was $5,975.2 million at June 30, 2026 versus $1,577.5 million at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $37,490.6 million (36% within 24 months; 40% in months 25-48); deferred revenue $5,975.2 million

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 customer and supplier concentration (6-K; customers not named): Customer C accounted for 24% of revenue in Q2 2026 (26% in the first half), Customer D for 21% (21% in the first half) and Customer E for 14% in Q2 2026; a year earlier Customer A was 39% and Customer B 15% of Q2 2025 revenue. Customer D held 16% and Customer E 29% of accounts receivable at June 30, 2026. Supplier concentration, measured on gross capital expenditures, was attributable to two suppliers as of December 31, 2025 and three suppliers as of June 30, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Customer C 24%, Customer D 21%, Customer E 14% of Q2 2026 revenue; three suppliers

quarterly_data.signal: First-half 2026 (6-K): Nebius AI cloud revenue grew by $829.5 million, or 614%, to $964.6 million, and Nebius AI cloud adjusted EBITDA was $459.7 million (versus a loss of $17.9 million); growth was driven by capacity scaling and supported by strong pricing and utilization. Purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets were $8,130.3 million in the six months ended June 30, 2026 (versus $1,054.5 million), relating primarily to investments in GPUs and GPU-related hardware and data center expansion. Q2 cost of revenues rose to $133.6 million, including a $73.8 million increase in co-location and operating lease expenses as infrastructure capacity scaled.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 Nebius AI cloud revenue $964.6 million (+614%); H1 capex $8,130.3 million

quarterly_data.signal: Committed capacity (6-K): as of June 30, 2026 Nebius had executed additional lease agreements, primarily for data center facilities as well as equipment, that had not yet commenced, with aggregate estimated future undiscounted lease payments of $12,054.1 million (prepayments of $612.4 million made); these leases are expected to commence between 2026 and 2027 with estimated lease terms of up to twelve years. Fixed or minimum guaranteed commitments under contracts primarily consisting of energy and power supply agreements for co-location arrangements and greenfield data center development were $81.7 million in 2026, $541.8 million in 2027, $542.0 million in 2028, $540.5 million in 2029, $535.8 million in 2030 and $3,082.3 million thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: not-yet-commenced leases $12,054.1 million (up to twelve years); energy and power supply commitments $3,082.3 million after 2030
